title: Valid Arrangement of Pairs
description:
You are given a 0-indexed 2D integer array pairs where pairs[i] = [start i , end i ] . An arrangement of pairs is valid if for every index i where 1 <= i < pairs.length , we have end i-1 == start i . 
 
 Return any valid arrangement of pairs .
